entries.11aa9b9d455fce4f: The sole reportable segment of the company group. Aluminium scrap is melted and refined as raw material to manufacture and sell aluminium secondary alloy ingots. entries.2ccc710bbf365015: This is because the following is printed: under 'History', the founding in 1922 (Japan's first secondary aluminum smelting business); under 'Business Overview', a system of purchasing aluminum scrap from subsidiaries and manufacturing and selling ingots; and under 'Status of Affiliated Companies', consolidated overseas subsidiaries such as those in Thailand and Indonesia.

entries.52b175ec871fb644: As its basic management policy, it sets out 'G&G (Global & Green)', and its corporate identity is to view 'business' and 'environment' on the same axis. It has drawn up its vision for 2030, "DAIKI∞NEXT∞", and its Medium-Term Management Plan 2024-2026 is built on pillars including investment in growth areas such as development and supply of recycled alloys for hybrid, electric and fuel-cell vehicles, strengthening the management base, environmental conservation, contribution to regions and society, and developing and utilizing people.
entries.5486db2d58e82544: It has a history of starting the secondary aluminum smelting business in Japan for the first time in 1922, and the group handles everything from procurement of aluminum scrap raw material to manufacture and sale of ingots. Including production bases overseas such as in Thailand and Indonesia, a system of procurement and supply close to customers can be read as its strength.
entries.5e9cdf1b9e076bb2: Sales of products and merchandise are its source of income. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥331,109 million, up 10.4% from the prior consolidated fiscal year. Higher product selling prices, among other things, are the cause of the revenue increase.
